database-schema.why: the stored shape every service reads; the migration sequence is its version

api.why: the request and response shapes a client outside this build depends on

contracts.why: the manifest a server and a host exchange before either trusts the other's answer

event-schemas.why: a domain event outlives the build that emitted it, so its reader needs to know its shape

sync-protocol.why: two devices reconciling rows have to agree on the exchange before they exchange anything

tool-schema.why: a stored tool call is replayed by a later build than the one that wrote it

mcp-integration.why: the protocol revision we speak to an MCP server, owned by the SDK and pinned here

model-registry.why: the catalogue every surface routes against, versioned so a stale copy is detectable

prompt-registry.why: the system prompt a conversation was answered under, pinned so a reply can be explained

policy-schema.why: the shape of a stored policy layer, separate from the tenant revision a value came from

entitlement-schema.why: what a plan carries, which a client may name and may never work out for itself

artifact-runtime.why: an artifact is opened by a later build than the one that produced it

plugin-manifest.why: three surfaces read the same plugin JSON and must refuse a shape they do not know

skill-manifest.why: a skill authored against one shape is loaded by a host built against another

connector-manifest.why: the connector list is served to clients older than the build that added a state

clientFloor.why: the oldest runtime the server still answers, so a dangerously old client is refused rather than half served
